summary.headline: Ganesh Housing Q1 FY27 revenue rose 86% YoY to Rs 280 crore on One 91 Thaltej land sale, but PAT fell to Rs 42 crore on a one-time tax hit.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue was Rs 280 crore, up 130% QoQ and 86% YoY, driven mainly by the One 91 Thaltej land sale and some completed old-project inventory. EBITDA was Rs 110 crore and PBT about Rs 105 crore, with PAT of Rs 42 crore held down by higher one-time tax on the land sale because the land's cost base came via the 2020 amalgamation. Management guided FY27 revenue of Rs 1,000-1,200 crore and PAT of Rs 300-325 crore, with Million Minds lease rentals starting in Q4 FY27. Management declined to disclose the sale consideration, citing the listed buyer's disclosure timing.

financial_highlights.change: Lower QoQ and YoY due to one-time tax on One 91 Thaltej land sale

financial_highlights.value: About 39% (as cited by analyst on Rs 280 crore revenue)

segments.name: One 91 Thaltej (land/project sale)
segments.commentary: Land sale completed in Q1 FY27 and reflected in revenue; management called it a project sale and said sale consideration will be disclosed only once the listed buyer is ready. Management estimated total sale value of about Rs 2,000-2,100 crore had it been developed over five years.

segments.name: Malabar Retreat (residential)
segments.commentary: Construction about 83% complete; 73 units booked (about 45% of units) for Rs 183 crore (about 45% of sale value). Sale value over Rs 450 crore; no revenue recognised in Q1 as project is incomplete.

segments.name: Million Minds (commercial leasing)
segments.commentary: Phase-I inaugurated; fit-out in final stages. LOIs executed for about 43% of leasable area (about 2.64 lakh sq ft), with a further 15-20% under negotiation. Lease rentals guided to start in Q4 FY27; FY28 rentals could exceed Rs 75 crore.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance of Rs 1,000-1,200 crore and PAT of Rs 300-325 crore; management said PAT could rise about 10% or merely be maintained given the one-time Q1 tax hit.

Management expects roughly Rs 700 crore of project sales (Malabar Retreat plus the completed One 91 Thaltej sale) and about Rs 470-600 crore of land-related revenue including possible Godhavi monetisation, if these are classed separately.
Cash flow realisation for FY27 estimated close to Rs 1,000 crore or Rs 700 crore, per management; GDV and cash flow metrics to be reported going forward.
Million Minds Phase-II launch expected in Q3 FY27 and Phase-I residential at Million Minds in Q4 FY27.
FY28 guidance not given; management said it would provide next-year guidance in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28.
capex_capacity: Land bank of about 510 acres, fully paid: Godhavi Township 411 acres and 65 acres at Million Minds.
Million Minds long-term development potential cited at about 15 billion sq ft across commercial, residential, hospitality, retail and social infrastructure.
Godhavi (Smile City) to be developed as a township mix of development, plotted development, construction and land sales; monetisation timing targeted for later in FY27, details not yet worked out.
Million Minds Phase-I funded entirely from internal accruals, per management.
demand_pricing: Malabar Retreat bookings: 73 units, about 45% of total units, Rs 183 crore sale value.
Million Minds demand from GCCs, technology companies and managed co-working operators; SEZ portion still open.
Management cited Ahmedabad infrastructure, metro, GIFT City, GCC growth and 2030 Commonwealth Games host status as demand drivers.
Management said Q1 margins were lower because land acquired through the 2020 amalgamation carried a higher cost base than Ganesh's historically low-cost land.

qa_highlights.question: When will the One 91 Thaltej sale be completed and what was the realisation? Is full payment received?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the sale is already complete and reflected in Q1 numbers, but the consideration and rate cannot be disclosed until the listed buyer is ready. Payments are said to normally come in along with the sale.

qa_highlights.question: Why sell Thaltej land rather than develop it, given the company is almost debt-free?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the five-year construction-plus-sales timeline (three years build, two years sell) carried execution-timing risk, and a present-value comparison favoured an upfront sale to fund Million Minds and land purchases. It said the decision was about value, not liquidity.

qa_highlights.question: Why are Q1 margins so low (about 39% versus a typical 85%) and is the tax the reason?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the land's amalgamation-based cost was higher than Ganesh's historical land cost, lowering EBITDA margin, and a one-time tax at a rate above the normal 25-27% reduced PAT. It said PBT was adequate.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Rs 500-600 crore land revenue split and what is the FY28 outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Rs 550-600 crore land component would mainly be Thaltej plus any further opportunities such as Godhavi, while Rs 470 crore is project-related. FY28 guidance was deferred to Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is the plan for the cash generated from the Thaltej sale?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said cash will be used to buy land at opportune moments, given many land opportunities in Ahmedabad, along with Million Minds development.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Million Minds rent outlook and Godhavi monetisation timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said rentals start in Q4 FY27 and FY28 could exceed Rs 75 crore. Godhavi monetisation is hoped for later in FY27, but details are not yet worked out.

risks_watch: Sale consideration and buyer identity for One 91 Thaltej are undisclosed, so the price and margin of the land sale cannot be verified.
Million Minds: whether the remaining 15-20% of leasable area is converted to binding leases and whether Q4 FY27 rent commencement holds.
Malabar Retreat completion timeline and collection of the Rs 183 crore booked value.
Reliance on land and one-off sales for FY27 revenue; PAT guidance depends heavily on one-off items.
Godhavi monetisation timing and terms, given management said the area is fluid and details are not worked out.
Management said cash flows and GDV disclosures will be added, but no figures were given.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategy and Million Minds, but defensive and evasive on the Thaltej sale: it declined to disclose price or buyer details and repeatedly deferred to the buyer's clearance. Management was candid that Q1 margins and PAT were affected by the tax and amalgamation-based land cost.
key_quotes: Monetization land under favorable market conditions enables us to accelerate cash generation, strengthen liquidity, and redeploy capital into opportunities that can deliver superior long-term returns.
We are pleased to share that approximately 60% of the leasable area is already under active discussion.
Tax in itself was higher than which normally the 25%-27% which we have, and that's the reason why the PBT is good enough, but PAT has been lower.
